Usage: codex exec [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]
Arguments:
  [PROMPT]
          If - is used, the prompt comes from a file. stdin supplies transport configuration.
Options:
  --output-schema <FILE>
  --output-last-message <FILE>
  --sandbox <SANDBOX_MODE>
          [possible values: read-only, workspace-write]
  --ignore-user-config
  --cd <DIR>
